use_when: 游戏手柄
游戏控制器
手柄输入
外设连接
如何在游戏中监听手柄设备的连接和断开事件？
如何查询当前所有在线的手柄设备信息（设备类型、厂商信息等）？
如何监听游戏手柄的按键事件（A/B/X/Y、肩键、扳机键、方向键等）？
如何监听游戏手柄左右摇杆的X/Y轴位移事件？
如何在动作游戏中通过手柄实现精确的操控响应？
如何在赛车游戏中利用摇杆轴事件控制方向和加速？
如何在射击游戏中绑定手柄按键实现瞄准和射击功能？
如何注册和取消设备状态变化事件监听？
当您正在开发需要支持手柄操控的游戏应用，需要监听手柄设备的连接和断开事件、查询在线手柄设备信息、以及捕获手柄的按键输入和摇杆轴位移输入时，应使用 Game Controller Kit
该 Kit 适用于所有需要将手柄作为输入设备的游戏场景，包括动作游戏、赛车游戏、射击游戏、格斗游戏等各类游戏类型，帮助游戏实现完整的手柄操控支持
接入蓝牙游戏手柄控制角色移动和攻击 / Integrate a Bluetooth gamepad to control character movement and attacks
监听手柄按键并映射到游戏操作指令 / Listen for controller button presses and map them to in-game actions
读取左右摇杆和扳机的模拟量输入 / Read analog input from both sticks and triggers
实现手柄热插拔后自动识别并切换输入源 / Handle controller hot-plugging and automatically switch input sources
获取已连接控制器的厂商名和设备标识 / Get vendor name and device identifiers for connected controllers
为双人同屏游戏管理多个手柄设备 / Manage multiple game controllers for local multiplayer
订阅控制器连接状态变化以更新游戏内提示 / Subscribe to controller connection changes to update in-game prompts
实现手柄按键自定义绑定和重映射 / Implement custom controller key binding and remapping
根据摇杆死区过滤输入避免角色漂移 / Apply stick deadzone filtering to prevent character drift
用手柄方向键和确认返回键操作游戏菜单 / Use the D-pad plus confirm/back buttons to navigate game menus
在游戏启动时扫描并选择可用的手柄设备 / Scan for and select available controllers when the game starts
统一处理手柄输入与触屏输入的切换 / Seamlessly switch between controller input and touch input
do_not_use_when: 需求是处理触摸屏、键盘、鼠标等通用输入事件而非游戏手柄事件，应改用 input-kit / The need is to handle general input events such as touchscreen, keyboard, or mouse rather than game controller events, so use input-kit instead

需求是获取加速度计、陀螺仪、方向等传感器数据，而不是手柄按键或摇杆轴输入，应改用 sensor-service-kit / The need is to obtain sensor data such as accelerometer, gyroscope, or orientation rather than controller buttons or stick axes, so use sensor-service-kit instead
需求是实现文本输入法、软键盘唤起或候选词处理，应改用 ime-kit / The need is to implement input methods, show soft keyboards, or handle candidate text, so use ime-kit instead
需求是支持手写笔设备、笔尖/压感/悬停等笔输入能力，应改用 pen-kit / The need is to support stylus devices and pen input features such as pressure or hover, so use pen-kit instead

需求是开发或适配底层设备驱动、内核级硬件接入，而不是在应用中监听已接入手柄事件，应改用 driver-development-kit / The need is to develop or adapt low-level device drivers and kernel-level hardware integration rather than listen to controller events in an app, so use driver-development-kit instead

需求是处理游戏震动、力反馈或机械外设控制而非手柄输入监听，应改用 mechanic-kit / The need is to handle game vibration, force feedback, or mechanical peripheral control rather than controller input listening, so use mechanic-kit instead
preconditions: 项目已集成支持该能力的 HarmonyOS SDK，并可使用对应的 C/C++ 原生接口 / The project has integrated a HarmonyOS SDK version that supports this capability and can use the corresponding C/C++ native APIs
应用工程已配置 Native/C++ 开发环境，相关源码与构建脚本可正常编译链接 / The app project has a native C/C++ development environment configured, and the relevant source files and build scripts can compile and link correctly
若要监听按键和轴事件，必须先完成设备上下线监听注册流程 / If button and axis events are to be monitored, the device online/offline listener registration flow must be completed first
测试或运行环境中存在可连接的受支持游戏手柄设备 / A supported game controller is available in the test or runtime environment
inputs: 设备状态变化监听回调 / device status change callback
手柄按键事件监听回调 / controller key event callback
手柄轴事件监听回调 / controller axis event callback
在线设备查询结果接收对象或遍历逻辑 / online device query receiver or iteration logic
手柄设备标识或设备信息结构 / controller device identifier or device info structure

postconditions.statement: 代码已注册手柄设备上下线监听，能够感知连接与断开事件 / The code registers a controller online/offline listener and can detect connect and disconnect events
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the agent's edit set add or wire up code that registers a game controller device connection/disconnection listener callback?

postconditions.statement: 代码包含在线手柄设备信息查询逻辑，能够获取当前已连接设备信息 / The code includes logic to query online controller device information and can obtain currently connected device details
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the agent's edit set add code that queries or enumerates currently online game controller devices and accesses their information?

postconditions.statement: 代码已在设备监听之后注册手柄按键或摇杆轴事件监听，用于处理游戏输入 / The code registers controller button or stick axis event listeners after device monitoring is set up, for handling game input
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there registration of controller key and/or axis event callbacks, and is it placed after or dependent on device listener setup?
